label: acetone-butanol-ethanol fermentation
definition: A fermentation in which solventogenic bacteria convert organic carbon sources to organic acids and then reassimilate those acids to produce acetone, butanol, and ethanol solvents.
observations: Product-specific solventogenic fermentation sibling of ethanol, propionic acid, and butyric acid fermentation; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an ABE fermentation duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
